panels.title: Battery Power Now

panels.description: Is collection happening right now? Green while the newest sample is under 5 minutes old, red past that -- the collector's poll loop never exits on failure, so "container up" says nothing. Matches the 'AlphaESS collector data stale' alert exactly. Ignores the time picker: this is always about now.
panels.title: Collector status

panels.description: Time since the last failed poll. Large and rising is the healthy state.
panels.title: Since last failure

panels.description: The one tile. DISPATCHING means the loop is alive, serving a fresh plan and writing. It stays green through 'hold' and 'self', which are decisions like any other and are most of a normal day - a tile that demanded an active command would be red by lunchtime and you would stop reading it. Red means the loop is trying and failing: BLIND is a Modbus read it could not do, NOT LANDING is a write the inverter took and did not honour. STALE PLAN means it is fine but flying on old information and will drop to idle. DRY RUN means it is deciding and writing nothing, on purpose. NO DISPATCHER means no point has arrived in five minutes: open the Dispatch dashboard, which has 'Last tick' and 'Why'.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dispatch_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "live" or r._field == "read_error"
                    or r._field == "verified" or r._field == "plan_run")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.live)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value:
      if exists r.read_error then "BLIND"
      else if exists r.verified and r.verified == 0 then "NOT LANDING"
      else if not exists r.plan_run then "NO PLAN"
      else if float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: time(v: r.plan_run))) / 1000000000.0 > 14400.0
        then "STALE PLAN"
      else if r.live == 0 then "DRY RUN"
      else "DISPATCHING" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Dispatcher

panels.description: What the PLAN asked for in the slot covering right now, from slot_action. 'no slot' is normal - it means the plan has nothing scheduled for this moment, not that the dispatcher is down. In dry run this is the only one of these four tiles that moves.

panels.title: Decision

panels.description: What the loop actually did with that decision. 'command' wrote the block; 'release' handed the battery back to self-consumption; 'idle' wrote nothing at all, which is the fail-safe. READ IT BESIDE 'Decision', because since #109 the two legitimately disagree: a hold whose charge target is already met releases to soak up surplus solar rather than freezing the battery while the sun spills. Decision 'hold' with Doing 'release' is that working, and 'Why', on the Dispatch dashboard, says so.

panels.title: Doing

panels.description: Time left on the dead man's switch. The loop rewrites it every 60 s, so this should sit near five minutes and never fall far; draining toward zero means the loop has stopped refreshing and the inverter is about to revert to self-consumption on its own. A grey 'no command' means nothing is dispatching, which is a normal resting state and the whole of a dry-run day, not a fault.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dispatch_state"
                   and (r._field == "expires_at" or r._field == "dispatch_active"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.expires_at and exists r.dispatch_active
                   and r.dispatch_active != 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value:
       float(v: r.expires_at) - float(v: int(v: now())) / 1000000000.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then 0.0 else r._value }))
  |> yield(name: "expires in")

panels.title: Command expires in

panels.description: Three lines on the same instant. 'planned' is the plan's SoC at the END of each interval, shifted onto that end so it lines up with a measurement taken there; 'actual' is the last reading in each 5-minute window, not a quarter-hour average, so a battery that stopped mid-slot shows as a flat stretch rather than a gentler slope. Both are drawn straight between points because SoC ramps; the two step lines are the ones that genuinely hold a value. Read the gaps: commanded against planned is a dispatcher problem, actual against commanded is a delivery one. A step-shaped gap of exactly one interval used to be a charting artefact and no longer is.

panels.title: Planned SoC vs actual SoC

panels.description: What the dispatcher will do next, as blocks - read from the translator's own slots rather than worked out again from the plan. Contiguous intervals with the same action, power and target are already merged into one slot, so a run of fifteen-minute discharges reads as one evening band. The neutral 'horizon end' block is where the plan stops; without it the last band would run to the edge of the panel and a horizon that ends at 22:00 would look like one that never ends.

defaults.noValue: no slots published - has the translator run since #113?

targets.query:
newest = (from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: -48h, stop: 72h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dispatch_slots" and r._field == "action")
  |> keep(columns: ["plan_run"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "plan_run")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ tag: r._value, t: time(v: r._value) }))
  |> sort(columns: ["t"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "tag"))[0]

nowS = float(v: int(v: now())) / 1000000000.0

// The whole of the newest run, elapsed slots included. Each panel narrows it differently.
run = from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: -48h, stop: 72h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dispatch_slots" and r.plan_run == newest)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

bands = run
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r.action }))
tail = run
  |> tail(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: time(v: int(v: r.end_s) * 1000000000),
                       _value: "horizon end" }))

union(tables: [bands, tail])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "slots")

panels.title: What the dispatcher will do next

panels.description: Estimated energy routing from sources (Solar / Battery discharge / Grid import) to uses (Home / Battery charge / Grid export) over the selected range. Set the time picker to a single day for a per-day flow. Links are modeled, not measured — see the query comment. Rendered with Apache ECharts (volkovlabs-echarts-panel).

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Amsterdam")

// AlphaESS only reports aggregate power per sample, not which source fed which
// sink. These links are ESTIMATED with a physical priority model applied at
// each sample, then integrated to kWh over the selected range:
//   Solar serves Home first, then charges Battery, then exports to Grid.
//   Home shortfall is covered by Battery first, then Grid import.
// Left/right totals still balance exactly; only the crossing links are inferred.
base = from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pv_power_w" or r._field == "load_power_w" or r._field == "battery_power_w" or r._field == "grid_power_w")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with pv: if exists r.pv_power_w then r.pv_power_w else 0.0, load: if exists r.load_power_w then r.load_power_w else 0.0, bat: if exists r.battery_power_w then r.battery_power_w else 0.0, grid: if exists r.grid_power_w then r.grid_power_w else 0.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with bdis: if r.bat > 0.0 then r.bat else 0.0, bchg: if r.bat < 0.0 then -r.bat else 0.0, gimp: if r.grid > 0.0 then r.grid else 0.0, gexp: if r.grid < 0.0 then -r.grid else 0.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with solar_to_load: if r.pv < r.load then r.pv else r.load }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with solarRem1: r.pv - r.solar_to_load, loadRem1: r.load - r.solar_to_load }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with battery_to_load: if r.bdis < r.loadRem1 then r.bdis else r.loadRem1 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with bdisRem1: r.bdis - r.battery_to_load, loadRem2: r.loadRem1 - r.battery_to_load }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with grid_to_load: if r.gimp < r.loadRem2 then r.gimp else r.loadRem2 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with gimpRem1: r.gimp - r.grid_to_load }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with solar_to_battery: if r.solarRem1 < r.bchg then r.solarRem1 else r.bchg }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with solarRem2: r.solarRem1 - r.solar_to_battery, bchgRem1: r.bchg - r.solar_to_battery }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with grid_to_battery: if r.gimpRem1 < r.bchgRem1 then r.gimpRem1 else r.bchgRem1 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with solar_to_grid: if r.solarRem2 < r.gexp then r.solarRem2 else r.gexp }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with gexpRem1: r.gexp - r.solar_to_grid }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with battery_to_grid: if r.bdisRem1 < r.gexpRem1 then r.bdisRem1 else r.gexpRem1 }))
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

sl = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.solar_to_load }))    |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Solar",       target: "Home",       value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
bl = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.battery_to_load }))  |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Battery out", target: "Home",       value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
gl = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.grid_to_load }))     |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Grid in",     target: "Home",       value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
sb = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.solar_to_battery })) |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Solar",       target: "Battery in", value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
gb = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.grid_to_battery }))  |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Grid in",     target: "Battery in", value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
sg = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.solar_to_grid }))    |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Solar",       target: "Grid out",   value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
bg = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _value: r.battery_to_grid }))  |> integral(unit: 1h) |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "Battery out", target: "Grid out",   value: r._value / 1000.0 }))

union(tables: [sl, bl, gl, sb, gb, sg, bg])
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.value > 0.01)
  |> yield(name: "flows")

panels.title: Energy Flow: Sources -> Uses

targets.query:
from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "soc_percent" or r._field == "pv_power_w" or r._field == "load_power_w")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
      net_power_w: (if exists r.pv_power_w then r.pv_power_w else 0.0)
                 - (if exists r.load_power_w then r.load_power_w else 0.0)
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "soc_percent", "pv_power_w", "load_power_w", "net_power_w"])

from(bucket: "alphaess")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pv_power_w" or r._field == "grid_power_w" or r._field == "load_power_w" or r._field == "battery_power_w")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._field == "battery_power_w" then -r._value else r._value }))

list.definition: capacity_wh from the newest plan point
list.description: Usable battery capacity in Wh, read from the newest `plan` point the planner wrote. The plan stores SoC in Wh and every percentage here divides by this, so it is sourced from the same run rather than kept in step by hand.
list.label: Capacity (Wh)
list.name: capacity_wh
list.query:
from(bucket: "planning")
  |> range(start: -14d, stop: 72h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plan" and r._field == "capacity_wh")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value, _run: time(v: r.plan_run)}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_run"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: string(v: int(v: r._value))}))
